title: pack's priced note fires on a unit cost asked as 'how many <units> does X cost', which asks for no money amount
goal: a good pack of 'How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?' carries no priced note and no route split, while 'What is the current price of a Microsoft 365 E5 licence?' keeps it (PRICE_ASK exempts a unit only after 'cost ... in'; found by the SP-4o3plg4l review)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts;p=kbfacts.pack('How many resource units does a Graph getMemberGroups call cost?');print(p.get('priced'));sys.exit(1 if p.get('priced') else 0)
